footer:
Ebb & Ember is Portland's floating sauna on the Columbia River. Real heat, snowmelt-cold river water, and a deck to sit on afterward. Sessions run 1 hour 45 minutes: heat, cold, recovery.

Open daily, 7am to 9pm. Social and private sessions available, from $49.
Location: 173 NE Bridgeton Rd, Portland OR 97211
Book: ebbandember.com
Instagram: @ebbandember

#Shorts #sauna #coldplunge #Portland #ColumbiaRiver

videos.title: Your Saturday Plans, Sorted | Floating Sauna and River Plunge in Portland
videos.intro: Sauna plus river plunge, 1 hour 45 minute sessions, social or private. Spots are limited, so book ahead if you're coming out this weekend.

videos.title: Ebb and Flow: How Heat and Cold Reset Your Nervous System | Ebb & Ember Portland
videos.intro: Ebb and flow. Heat and cold. Stillness and movement. We use the heat and the river to help your nervous system drop out of fight or flight. More than a sweat, a reset.

videos.title: 8pm on a Weeknight, in the Sauna Watching the Sunset | Ebb & Ember Portland
videos.intro: 8pm on a weekday, and instead of scrolling you're in the sauna watching the sunset over the river. This is what it looks like when self care becomes part of your routine, and with memberships it can be.

videos.title: Sometimes You Don't Need to Fix Everything | Floating Sauna in Portland
videos.intro: Sometimes you don't need to fix everything. You just need heat, cold water, fresh air, and an hour away from your phone.

videos.title: Views That Make It Hard to Leave the Sauna | Ebb & Ember on the Columbia River
videos.intro: Views like this make it hard to leave the sauna. Rain, sun, whatever Portland decides to do, it's always a good time to be out here.

videos.title: Your Official Summer Invite | Floating Sauna on the Columbia River, Portland
videos.intro: Consider this your official summer invite. River days, good books, and just vibing. That's the whole plan.

videos.title: The Summer Punch Pass Is Here | Ebb & Ember Floating Sauna, Portland
videos.intro: Committing to your summer just got easier. The Summer Punch Pass works solo or split with friends, valid for up to a year, book any time. 3 punches $159, 5 for $245, 10 for $400.

videos.title: Sauna Really Does Help: The Benefits of Heat and Cold | Ebb & Ember Portland
videos.intro: It's true, sauna really does help. Time in the heat supports heart health, circulation, muscle recovery, and stress. Paired with cold, it helps your nervous system reset.

videos.title: Sauna, But Make It Intentional | Ebb & Ember Floating Sauna, Portland
videos.intro: Sauna, but make it intentional. A few small shifts can completely change your experience.

videos.title: A Floating Sauna Date on the Columbia River | Ebb & Ember Portland
videos.intro: Heat, cold water, and the river, together. A private floating sauna session makes for a different kind of date in Portland.

videos.title: More Than a Sauna, It's a Ritual | Ebb & Ember on the Columbia River
videos.intro: More than just a sauna, it's a ritual. Come share the heat, the stillness, and the reset.

videos.title: Treat Yourself to a Private Floating Sauna | Ebb & Ember Portland
videos.intro: Sometimes the move is a private floating sauna session on the Columbia River, just you and your people, up to 10 guests.
